mapper.select: SELECT * FROM section_view WHERE site_id = #{site_id} ORDER BY section
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO section(site_id, section, name, floor, useyn, write_user_id, write_time) VALUES (#{site_id}, #{section}, #{section_name}, #{floor} 'Y', #{write_user_id}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT SEC.* FROM section SEC LEFT JOIN scanner S ON S.site_id = SEC.site_id AND S.place_id = SEC.place_id AND S.section = SEC.section WHERE S.id is NULL AND SEC.section = #{section}
